observation.visible_scene: A close-up, eye-level view of a dimpled glass mug filled with amber beer, topped by a mounded white foam head that rises above the rim. The background is a flat, uniform gray. Bright rectangular highlight patches (reflections) sit on the upper front of the glass, and a curved glossy reflection appears on the right side of the liquid. The glass and background remain in fixed screen position throughout.
visible_changes: The foam head slowly settles and coarsens: the smooth creamy surface seen early on develops more distinct, larger individual bubbles across the top and sides as the excerpt progresses.
The overall height and outline of the foam mound above the rim stay largely constant, with only a slight apparent lowering/compaction of the top edge.
The boundary line between the white foam and the amber liquid remains at a steady level inside the glass.
Sparse small bubbles are visible within the amber liquid near the right side, with no large-scale movement of the liquid itself.
The highlight/reflection patches on the glass do not move, indicating the camera and glass are stationary.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the beer was poured and the foam's earlier, fresher state before this segment.
Whether the foam continues to deflate or the glass is later moved or drunk from after this excerpt ends.
uncertain_details: Whether there is a measurable drop in foam height versus only a change in bubble texture; the vertical change is very subtle.
Whether the few specks in the liquid are rising bubbles or static inclusions/refractions.
